caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame with a thin brown border enclosing a floral composition. At the center, there is a circular wreath made up of green leaves with small red, yellow, and blue flowers interspersed throughout. Inside the wreath, there are two pinkish flower buds with green stems and leaves crossing each other. In each of the four corners, there are separate colored floral elements: the upper left and lower right corners have blue leaves and a small pink bud, the upper right and lower left corners have a large yellow and orange flower with green stems and smaller green leaves. At the top center, above the wreath, is the text "To Kate Carpenter." Below the circular wreath, there is a four-line handwritten poem, and at the bottom right below the poem are the words "Morristown Aug. 1852. Maria Godwin Gray." The color scheme consists primarily of green for leaves, accented with blue, yellow, orange, red, and pink for the flowers, all set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Square)
